additional_info.subject: From Customer
additional_info.body:
Good morning Siemens team,
we have a problem with the charging station MP/PN170001051.
We get the following message via OCPP:
"connector_id": "0",
"error_code": "OtherError",
"info": null,
"status": "Faulted",
"timestamp": "2025-02-05T08:32:11.891Z",
"vendor_error_code": "DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4",
"vendor_id": "SICHARGE D"
A colleague was on site and said that the station is lit up red but is not on.
Can you please take a look at this?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0404396-DC/SiC-D/DE [MP / PN 170001051] Door Open Alarm CRM:00579001474
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
I have reviewed the charger logs and identified the DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4 error, which is causing the charger outlets to be out of order.
This issue can occur due to several reasons:
The front or back door was opened.
Faulty door sensors.
Door switch wiring issues that require further tracing.
Additionally, bring the following devices for troubleshooting or replacement, if necessary:
2 x 3SE5232-0HC05:
Door Position Switch (1x NO / 1x NC) for BG3 and BG4.
Please check the connections at the terminals highlighted in the below snap.
With charger OFF and Door Switch pressed there should be a continuity in the emergency line.
Also you can check if door switch have the continuity with switch pressed
Need to check emergency circuit as follows:
1) Check whether BG3 is working properly, we have continuity on point 13 and 14
2) Check whether we have 24V supply along XD9.
3) Trace 24 v supply in emergency circuit till QA26.
Do let us know if you have any queries?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
